It adds a blocking compatibility check rather than removing an existing gate. Existing read-only workflow permissions, credential-free checkout, push-only cache saves, runner routing, shard execution/auditing, and fail-closed Provider Tests result checks are unchanged.
The addition is relevant to native-runtime availability (TB-007, A-018) and artifact qualification assumptions (A-017, T-054); it does not visibly change serving authorization, attestation, request encryption, billing, or prompt/cache exposure (including T-041). No concrete security regression is supported by this workflow change. Integration should examine scripts/check-date-comparisons.py, scripts/test-check-date-comparisons.py, and scripts/test-check-provider-weak-imports.py, along with the claimed release binary check, to establish checker behavior and coverage. Those implementations are not supplied here, so this pass cannot validate the new compatibility control or its interaction with release gating.
